title: fissile measure output
description: `fissile measure --format json` (FS-007-measure.2): one record per (file, rule), plus one per file no rule measures. Records follow the caller's file order, and a file measured in two units appears once per rule.

unit.description: The unit the matched rule measures in.

actual.description: The file's measured value in `unit`, counted the way the rule counts (FS-001-config.3.1).

rule_id.description: The effective rule for this file and unit.

soft.description: The rule's soft limit; omitted when the rule declares none.

hard.description: The rule's hard limit; omitted when the rule declares none.

soft_accepted.description: Ceiling the soft registry records for this path and rule; omitted when no entry matches.

hard_accepted.description: Ceiling the hard registry records for this path and rule; omitted when no entry matches.

headroom.description: Signed distance to `headroom_to`: positive is room left below it, negative the distance past it. Omitted when the rule declares no threshold at all.

headroom_to.description: The threshold `headroom` is measured against: the lowest one above the value, or the highest one below it.

unruled.description: A file no rule measures. Emitted rather than dropped so a consumer can tell `not measured here` from `not in the output` (FS-007-measure.2).
